basis: Step 3 of the provenance rule (CEO-approved on AFC-194 and on this issue): the merge-in protocol, as a git commit-msg hook that refuses a compliance-path commit without a registry claim (R1) or a named reviewer (R2).
notCompliancePath: scripts/merge-in-gate.sh is NOT on the R2 list. R2 names scripts/retention-literal-gate.sh specifically. This gate is on the DIRTY list (all of scripts/) and not on the R2 list, so this commit needs no Reviewed-by trailer of its own.
doesNotClaim: This claim asserts who wrote the change. It is not a licence and it cannot exempt anything. It also claims nothing on services/directus/schema/engine/**, services/directus/schema/migrations/**, tests/db/** or scripts/retention-literal-gate.sh, so a commit touching those still requires its own claim and a named reviewer.
